name: system_logs
description: Consulta e leitura de logs técnicos do sistema, API, skills e interfaces.

actions.name: list
actions.description: Lista categorias de logs disponíveis e seus arquivos.

actions.name: read
actions.description: Lê as últimas N linhas de um arquivo de log específico.

file.description: Log filename to read (e.g., llm.log, telegram.log, assistant.log).

lines.description: Number of lines to read (default: 20, max: 100).

context_map.assistant.log: Unified log containing all system activity. Use for general debugging.
context_map.llm.log: Natural language processing logs. Use for AI response errors or prompt issues.
context_map.telegram.log: External chat driver logs. Use for Telegram connection or message delivery issues.
context_map.web.log: Frontend and WebSocket driver logs. Use for web UI connectivity issues.
context_map.api.log: Portal server routes and endpoint logs. Use for API errors (auth, database).
context_map.skills.log: Modular skill execution logs. Use when a specific command/skill fails to execute.
